guide.title: How to register the webhook in the Meta App
guide.intro: Register the webhook below in the Meta for Developers dashboard (Product WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhooks → Edit). App ID, App Secret and Verify Token above must be saved first.
guide.webhookUrlHelp: Paste this URL into the Callback URL field of the Meta App. In dev, BMS_PUBLIC_URL points at a tunnel (ngrok / cloudflare-tunnel) reachable from the outside.
guide.missingPublicUrlBody: Set BMS_PUBLIC_URL in the msgops-api .env (in dev, use your ngrok URL pointing at port 5001) and restart so this URL shows up here.
guide.verifyTokenHelp: Use the same value saved in "Verify Token (webhook)" above. Meta hits this with a GET handshake and BMS responds with the challenge when they match.
guide.eventsHelp: Subscribe to these events only. The others (flows, smb_*, history) generate traffic with no matching action in the BMS.
guide.steps: Order: 1) Save credentials above. 2) In Meta App → WhatsApp → Configuration, paste the URL + Verify Token and click Verify and save. 3) In Webhook fields, subscribe to the 5 events listed. 4) Done — when an account connects via Embedded Signup, events arrive at /webhooks/meta.

guide.title: Automatic setup
guide.body: You do NOT need to register a webhook or pick events on the EvoHub dashboard. When an account clicks "Connect via EvoHub", BMS calls the Hub's POST /api/v1/channels passing webhook_url, webhook_secret and the WhatsApp event whitelist. The Hub creates the channel and the associated webhook in a single operation.
guide.publicUrlReminder: BMS_PUBLIC_URL must point at an endpoint the Hub can reach (in dev: ngrok or cloudflare-tunnel pointing at msgops-api port 5001).

sendgridPlatform.scopeTitle: Scope: BMS platform (does not affect campaign sends)
sendgridPlatform.scopeNote: These settings only affect the BMS platform's own SendGrid infrastructure: API key used for internal notifications (emails BMS sends on its own behalf, e.g. resets, alerts), provider base URL (real vs mock), Event Webhook URL, and default IP Sender. This does NOT replace each customer account's API Key — that's configured by each operator in Settings → SendGrid.
sendgridPlatform.apiKeyHelp: Key used only by BMS itself to send internal emails. NOT used for customer accounts' campaign sends.
